description: Erection of a single storey side infill extension to the house
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Flood risk assessment, design and access statement, location plan, existing block plan, HS/VA 19 3 01, HS/VA 19 3 02, HS/VA 19 3 04, HS/VA 19 4 05, HS/VA 19 3 06 A, HS/VA 19 3 07, HS/VA 19 3 08 A, HS/VA 19 3 09, HS/VA 19 3 10 A. Received 01/05/19.  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the side elevation of the extension hereby approved shall be obscure glazed, and fixed from opening up to 1.7m from internal floor level, and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscure glazing.
